card.name: Just before dosing frequency phrases
card.fires_on: The word, bracket, space or unit right after a dose or site and just before a frequency such as twice a day, 3 times daily or t.i.d. Found in dosage instructions.

modes.label: Closing bracket before frequency
modes.description: A closing parenthesis after a drug amount or body site, followed by how often to take it.
modes.example: Instill one drop of Bepotastine Besilate Ophthalmic Solution into the affected eye(s<<)>> twice a day.

modes.label: Unit or space after dose number
modes.description: The unit mg or a space after a dose number, right before times per day.
modes.example: The initial dose of captopril tablets, USP is 25<< mg>> b.i.d. or t.i.d

modes.label: Word end before frequency
modes.description: The last piece of a site word, such as nostril, before a times-a-day phrase.
modes.example: this dose may be increased to 2 sprays in each nostr<<il>> 3 times a day (total dose

card.writes: It pushes toward daily time-of-day words such as morning, afternoon and hour, and away from longer spans such as weeks and months.
card.plain: It marks the spot right before the text says how many times a day to take a dose.
